tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about one specific Cerulean listing — its responsibilities, qualifications, skills, experience, education, pay when the employer states it, benefits or required languages — and its id or Cerulean URL is known. Returns that one listing in full as text, with its url and structured details. It does not search. An unknown or closed listing is an error.

id.description: The listing's id, as every result carries it, or its URL on a Cerulean site.

locale.description: The user's language and region, as a BCP 47 tag: fr-CH for someone writing French in Geneva, say. It sets the language of titles and descriptions where a listing has it, and adds localizedUrl, the listing's page in its title's language on its country's Cerulean site, where there is one. It does not filter: country and location do. Cerulean's sites are en: ceruleanjobs.com, English, worldwide; fr-FR: cerulean.fr, French, France; fr-CH: ceruleanjobs.ch, French, Switzerland; de-CH: ceruleanjobs.ch, German, Switzerland; en-CA: ceruleanjobs.ca, English, Canada; fr-CA: ceruleanjobs.ca, French, Canada; de-DE: ceruleanjobs.de, German, Germany; en-GB: ceruleanjobs.co.uk, English, UK; es-ES: cerulean.es, Spanish, Spain; it-IT: ceruleanjobs.it, Italian, Italy; en-US: ceruleancareers.com, English, USA. Any other tag takes its language's site, so fr-BE reads as fr-FR and en-US as en; another language reads as en. Defaults to en.

tools.name: find_similar_jobs
tools.description: Use this when someone wants more roles like one specific Cerulean listing: the closest open roles by what the job is and where it is. Takes that listing's id, not keywords. If the listing is unknown or has no similarity data, it returns an error rather than unrelated results.

id.description: The id of the listing to find roles like, as every result carries it, or its URL on a Cerulean site. It is not among its own results.

location.description: Keep only similar roles in this city, region or country.

country.description: Keep only similar roles in this country.

locale.description: The user's language and region, as a BCP 47 tag: fr-CH for someone writing French in Geneva, say. It sets the language of titles and descriptions where a listing has it, and adds localizedUrl, the listing's page in its title's language on its country's Cerulean site, where there is one. It does not filter: country and location do. Cerulean's sites are en: ceruleanjobs.com, English, worldwide; fr-FR: cerulean.fr, French, France; fr-CH: ceruleanjobs.ch, French, Switzerland; de-CH: ceruleanjobs.ch, German, Switzerland; en-CA: ceruleanjobs.ca, English, Canada; fr-CA: ceruleanjobs.ca, French, Canada; de-DE: ceruleanjobs.de, German, Germany; en-GB: ceruleanjobs.co.uk, English, UK; es-ES: cerulean.es, Spanish, Spain; it-IT: ceruleanjobs.it, Italian, Italy; en-US: ceruleancareers.com, English, USA. Any other tag takes its language's site, so fr-BE reads as fr-FR and en-US as en; another language reads as en. Defaults to en.

limit.description: How many similar roles to return, up to 20. Defaults to 12.

offset.description: How many to skip, for the next page. Defaults to 0, maximum 10000.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to find, browse, count or compare open roles at luxury houses and brands, the newest openings included. The listings are read from the houses' own career sites every four hours, and closed roles drop out. query takes keywords or a plain request ("senior client advisor, Bulgari, Geneva"), and may be empty to browse; brand, place, employment type, seniority, industry and department can also be set as filters, and they combine; posted_within_days keeps only recent listings. Returns one page of listings — each with an id, a short summary and the url where candidates read it and apply — plus total, the number of matches.

query.description: Keywords, or the request as a plain sentence ("senior client advisor, Bulgari, Geneva"). A brand, place, country or employment type it names is applied as that filter, unless the filter is set, and reported in interpreted. Leave it out, or empty, to browse by filters alone.

brand.description: A brand, by name or slug: "Tiffany & Co.", "LV", "louis-vuitton". A name that matches no brand comes back as an unknown_value warning with close spellings.

location.description: A city, region or country, in any common spelling: "Geneva" or "Genève", "New York" or "NYC", "Lombardy", "UAE".

country.description: A country, by name or ISO code — "Switzerland", "US", "Deutschland". Narrower than location, and combinable with it.

locale.description: The user's language and region, as a BCP 47 tag: fr-CH for someone writing French in Geneva, say. It sets the language of titles and descriptions where a listing has it, and adds localizedUrl, the listing's page in its title's language on its country's Cerulean site, where there is one. It does not filter: country and location do. Cerulean's sites are en: ceruleanjobs.com, English, worldwide; fr-FR: cerulean.fr, French, France; fr-CH: ceruleanjobs.ch, French, Switzerland; de-CH: ceruleanjobs.ch, German, Switzerland; en-CA: ceruleanjobs.ca, English, Canada; fr-CA: ceruleanjobs.ca, French, Canada; de-DE: ceruleanjobs.de, German, Germany; en-GB: ceruleanjobs.co.uk, English, UK; es-ES: cerulean.es, Spanish, Spain; it-IT: ceruleanjobs.it, Italian, Italy; en-US: ceruleancareers.com, English, USA. Any other tag takes its language's site, so fr-BE reads as fr-FR and en-US as en; another language reads as en. Defaults to en.

posted_within_days.description: Only listings posted in the last N days, by when Cerulean first saw them: 1 for today's, 7 for this week's. Up to 365.

limit.description: How many results to return, up to 20. Defaults to 12; more than 20 is served as 20 with a clamped warning.

offset.description: How many results to skip, for the next page. Defaults to 0, maximum 10000.
